structure: CSharp first wraps a long inline control arrow, then computes logical indentation. SLG emits the split line while appending, using an explicit arrow indentation.
branches: CSharp adds one level to continuation lines after base depth and active continuation blocks. SLG passes (baseDepth+continuationCount+1)*4 to appendFormattedLine, without adding a second level for an existing and/or continuation.
logic: Keep the original condition/control block owner and exact expected bytes. All8 original source bytes and oracles match the preserved baseline and current CSharp/Native results.
diagnostics: Historical Native3/8 output mismatches; current exact bytes8/8 on both compilers. These are formatter stdin observations; unused stdlib hashes recorded by the legacy harness are not treated as actual formatter input.
